subject: spec-kit
tagline: Specification-driven development: specs are the source of truth; commands + YAML workflows + gates generate the plan and the code.

capabilities.name: SDD command spine
capabilities.description: specify → plan → tasks → implement as markdown commands, not SKILL.md.

capabilities.name: YAML workflow + gates
capabilities.description: Steps can be commands or type: gate (approve/reject) with persisted state.

capabilities.name: Extension system
capabilities.description: extension.yml adds namespaced speckit.<ext>.<cmd> commands, hooks, catalogs.

capabilities.name: Agent-context overlay
capabilities.description: Opt-in managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md block — routing, not the encyclopedia.

capabilities.name: Presets and bundles
capabilities.description: Role stacks compose extensions+presets; community catalog is discovery-only.

capabilities.name: Spec persistence models
capabilities.description: Declares flow-back / flow-forward / living-spec instead of silent drift.

unique_selling_points: Specs invert power: code serves the spec
Contrast case: structure without Agent Skills

limitations.description: Almost no SKILL.md surface (1 file); discovery is slash commands
No personas, org-chart, or skill bootstrap
